description: Real-time readings (typically 15-minute cadence) from a USGS gauge. Returns one or more time series, by default discharge (00060, ft³/s) and gage height (00065, ft), over a relative period ending now. Use this to answer 'what is the river doing right now?'. USGS rejects historic dates on this endpoint; for past data use `get_daily_values` with start_date/end_date instead. For a 'what gauges exist near here?' first-step query use `search_sites`.

parameter_codes.description: Specific 5-digit parameter codes to retrieve. Defaults to ['00060', '00065'] (discharge + gage height). Pass ['00010'] for water temperature, etc.

items.description: USGS 5-digit parameter code. Common values: '00060' = streamflow / discharge in ft³/s; '00065' = gage height in feet; '00010' = water temperature in °C. Full list: https://help.waterdata.usgs.gov/codes-and-parameters/parameters

period.description: Relative time window ending now. Default 'PT2H' (past 2 hours, returns ~8 readings at 15-minute cadence). 'P1D' returns ~96 readings.

sites.description: Array of USGS site numbers to fetch in one call. Most queries pass a single site, but the API supports batched fetches.

items.description: USGS site number, 8 to 15 digits identifying a single gauging station. Examples: '12045500' (Elwha River at McDonald Bridge near Port Angeles, WA); '12048000' (Dungeness River near Sequim, WA). Use `search_sites` to discover site numbers for a region.

name: get_instantaneous_values
title: Real-Time USGS Streamflow / Gage Height
